sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas showing pictorial scenarios (nail hammered vs.
lying flat; thumbtack vs. blunt stick pressing skin; tank tread vs.
car tire on sand). Each scene has a force arrow (same magnitude) and
a "contact area" indicator. Student toggles between scenarios and
reads a p = F/S bar. HUD: F (N), S (cm²), p (Pa or bar). Observe:
same force, different area → different pressure — heart of the
concept. Experiment: given a target "does it penetrate?" outcome,
pick a scenario. Evaluate: pressure bar hidden; student selects
(multiple choice) which scenario causes greater penetration effect.
Wrinkle: 1ère-depth — numbers are illustrative, no unit calculations.
